title: Admin web pages
interface: Blueprint `bp` (name 'admin', url_prefix '/admin'), every route admin_required, templates rendered with render_template. GET /admin/assets?q=&status=&type= -> 'admin/assets.html' (list). GET /admin/assets/new -> 'admin/asset_form.html' (empty form, ASSET_TYPES for the select); POST /admin/assets/new -> create via AssetService, flash + redirect to /admin/assets/<id>; validation error -> re-render form with the error (status 400 is NOT required; 200 with error shown is fine). GET /admin/assets/<int:id> -> 'admin/asset_detail.html' with asset, its handovers (list_for_asset with details), assignment history, the open assignment's employee, active employees for the handover picker; unknown -> 404. GET/POST /admin/assets/<int:id>/edit -> 'admin/asset_form.html' prefilled / update + redirect to detail. POST /admin/assets/<int:id>/handover form {employee_email, note} -> start_handover, flash, redirect to detail (HandoverError -> flash error, redirect). POST /admin/assets/<int:id>/return -> start_return, redirect to detail. POST /admin/assets/<int:id>/retire and POST /admin/assets/<int:id>/lost -> redirect to detail. GET /admin/handovers?status= -> 'admin/handovers.html' (with details). POST /admin/handovers/<int:id>/cancel -> redirect back. GET /admin/employees?q= -> 'admin/employees.html'. GET /admin/employees/<path:email> -> 'admin/employee_detail.html' with the employee and overview_for_employee; unknown -> 404. GET /admin/audit -> 'admin/audit.html' (list_recent(200)). Services from src/services/factory.py on get_db(). Use flask.abort(404) for unknown ids.

uses.HandoverService: src/services/handover_service.py (start_handover, start_return, cancel, with_details, overview_for_employee, handovers/assignments/employees repositories as attributes, HandoverError)
uses.config constants: src/config.py: ASSET_TYPES, ASSET_STATUSES, HANDOVER_KINDS, HANDOVER_STATUSES, load_config(overrides) -> dict

database: services from src/services/factory.py on get_db() per request
